contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

A group of nine sherds from Roman Samian ware vessels. They have a combined total weight of 58.92g and date to between the 2nd and 3rd centuries AD. 1) A rim sherd from a Central Gaulish (SACG) platter or dish of Ludowici Tg form.
